note: The core REST limit is simultaneous in-flight requests, not requests per second. Sender throughput is a separate axis measured in messages per second.

rest_api.retry_note: 429 responses are never processed — zero side effects

sms_throughput_mps.overflow_behaviour: queued, not throttled — does not return 429

20429.meaning: too many concurrent REST API requests
20429.note: request never processed; safe to retry

20429_verify.meaning: Verify attempt limit or configured Service Rate Limit
20429_verify.fix: check existing verification instead of starting a new one

51202.meaning: Twilsock connection or upstream request limit
51202.fix: reuse the SDK connection; do not create new clients per call

60245.fix: contact support for a volume review

31206.meaning: client request rate exceeds authorised limit

retry_guidance.primary_fix: cap concurrency with a semaphore or bounded queue — not longer backoff
retry_guidance.backoff: exponential, 3–5 attempts, respect retry-after when present
retry_guidance.branch_on: twilio error code, not HTTP status

escape_hatch: treat Twilio-Concurrent-Requests as a fuel gauge; throttle new connections when it climbs past 80
